title: 6220-mod
description: This is the Minecraft mod for First Robotic Competition Team 6220. It adds items from the 2025 season of FRC including Algae and Coral, and also adds our bot as a tameable pet in the game.
body:
This is the Minecraft mod for First Robotic Competition Team 6220. It adds items from the 2025 season of FRC including Algae and Coral, and also adds our bot as a tameable pet in the game. This would be a great mod for FRC teams wanting a FRC themed minecraft server. Currently it is very small and adds 2 items and a mob:

Coral- Can be fed to Nessie to breed them(also drops as loot)
Algae- crafted using 9 coral
nessie- our robot, can be tamed and breeded using coral
